description: This is a Java test class for the AnySoftKeyboard project, specifically testing power saving features and behaviors related to battery state, suggestions, overlays, and UI indicators.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardPowerSavingTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing power saving features in AnySoftKeyboard, including battery state reactions, suggestion behavior, overlay application, and UI indicators.

methods.name: testDoesNotAskForSuggestionsIfInLowBattery
methods.description: Tests that suggestions are not asked for when the device is in low battery state.

methods.name: testAskForSuggestionsIfInLowBatteryButPrefIsDisabled
methods.description: Tests suggestion behavior when low battery state occurs but the user preference disables suggestions.

methods.name: testDoesNotAskForSuggestionsIfPowerSavingAlways
methods.description: Verifies that suggestions are suppressed when power saving mode is set to 'always'.

methods.name: testAskForSuggestionsIfPowerSavingNever
methods.description: Verifies that suggestions are active when power saving mode is set to 'never'.

methods.name: testDictionariesStateCycle
methods.description: Checks the enabling/disabling cycle of suggestion dictionaries based on power saving and preferences.

methods.name: testIconShownWhenTriggered
methods.description: Ensures the power saving watermark icon appears when battery is low and disappears when battery is normal.

methods.name: testIconShownWhenAlwaysOn
methods.description: Verifies that the watermark icon remains visible when power saving mode is set to 'always'.

methods.name: testIconShownWhenNeverOn
methods.description: Verifies that the watermark icon does not appear when power saving mode is set to 'never'.

methods.name: testCallOverlayOnPowerSavingSwitchEvenIfOverlaySettingOff
methods.description: Tests that overlay updates are triggered when switching power saving states, even if overlay setting is off.

methods.name: testSetPowerSavingOverlayWhenLowBattery
methods.description: Checks overlay color changes when battery is low and overlay theme control is enabled.

methods.name: testDisablesGestureTypingOnLowPower
methods.description: Verifies gesture typing is disabled during low power states when configured.

methods.name: testDoesNotSetPowerSavingThemeWhenLowBatteryIfPrefDisabled
methods.description: Ensures no theme change occurs if the overlay control preference is disabled during low battery.
